dash.name: Dashboard
dash.subNoName: What is happening in this workspace
dash.none: Every card is hidden. Press Edit layout to show some again.
dash.error: This card could not be loaded
dash.edit.resetDone: The dashboard layout is back to the default
dash.edit.hint: Drag a card by its handle, or focus the handle and use the arrow keys (Home and End move it to the start or the end). Pick S, M or L for its size.
dash.edit.moveAria: Move {title}, card {pos} of {count}. Arrow keys move it.
dash.edit.moveHint: Drag to move, or use the arrow keys
dash.pulse.title: Run pulse
dash.pulse.desc: What your agents are doing right now and what today cost.
dash.pulse.costPartial: (plus runs on your plan, which report no cost)
dash.pulse.emptyWhy: Runs you start in IntelyIDE show up here with their state and cost.
dash.burn.title: Burn-down
dash.burn.desc: How much of your plan's 5-hour and weekly limits is used, and what you spent.
dash.burn.noClaude: Plan limits need the Claude CLI, which was not found.
dash.burn.notSignedIn: Plan limits show once you are signed in to Claude.
dash.burn.limitsFailed: The plan limits could not be read just now.
dash.burn.estimate: API-equivalent estimate from the runs started in IntelyIDE, not a bill.
dash.burn.emptyWhy: Once a run has finished a turn, its cost shows up here.
dash.repos.title: Repo heartbeat
dash.repos.desc: Branch, ahead and behind, uncommitted changes and the last commit of every repository.
dash.repos.unreadable: The repository could not be read
dash.repos.more: {n, plural, one {and # more repository} other {and # more repositories}}
dash.repos.emptyWhy: Add a repository to the workspace to see its branch and changes here.
dash.prs.title: CI & PRs
dash.prs.desc: Your open pull requests and their checks, through the GitHub CLI.
dash.prs.noGhWhy: Install gh and sign in with gh auth login to see your pull requests here.
dash.prs.blocked: Pull requests are not asked for right now
dash.prs.blockedWhy: The safety mode stops network calls of the GitHub CLI.
dash.prs.emptyWhy: Pull requests of your current branches and the ones you opened show up here.
dash.sentry.title: Sentry triage
dash.sentry.desc: The busiest unresolved issues nobody has taken in the last 24 hours, with one-click Fix.
dash.sentry.emptyWhy: No unresolved, unassigned issue had events in the last 24 hours.
dash.servers.title: Dev servers
dash.servers.desc: The servers the Run panel started, with ports and memory.
dash.servers.failedAction: The server could not be changed
dash.servers.emptyWhy: Start npm run dev or another script from the Run panel; it shows up here with its port.
dash.chat.title: Team chat
dash.chat.desc: Unread messages and mentions of the team chat.
dash.chat.allReadWhy: Channels with unread messages show up here.
dash.brief.title: Morning brief
dash.brief.desc: What the runs of the night did, from the night queue.
dash.brief.files: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} changed, +{add} −{del}
dash.brief.emptyWhy: Queue runs for the night in the night queue; their brief shows up here in the morning.
dash.tips.title: Stack tips
dash.tips.desc: Starter prompts that fit what your project is built with.
dash.tips.unknown: No known stack found: general starters.
dash.tips.why: Start opens the New run dialog filled in; nothing runs until you press Start run.
dash.tips.noReposWhy: Add a repository to get starter prompts for its stack.
dash.tip.expoOffline.title: Make the app work offline
dash.tip.expoOffline.prompt: Make this Expo app usable without a network connection: cache the data the main screens need, show a clear offline banner, and retry pending changes when the connection is back. Explain what you changed.
dash.tip.expoIcons.title: Polish the app icon and splash screen
dash.tip.expoIcons.prompt: Check the app icon, adaptive icon and splash screen configuration of this Expo app, fix missing or wrong sizes, and make the splash screen match the app's colours in light and dark mode.
dash.tip.rnSafeArea.title: Fix layouts on notches and small screens
dash.tip.rnSafeArea.prompt: Go through the screens of this React Native app and make them respect safe areas, notches and small screens (iPhone SE size), and handle the keyboard covering inputs. List the screens you changed.
dash.tip.rnDarkMode.title: Add a dark mode that follows the system
dash.tip.rnDarkMode.prompt: Add a dark mode to this React Native app that follows the system setting: move hard-coded colours into a theme, and check that text stays readable in both modes.
dash.tip.nextStates.title: Add loading and error states to every page
dash.tip.nextStates.prompt: Add loading, empty and error states to every route of this Next.js app (loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found), with friendly copy and a retry where it makes sense.
dash.tip.nextSeo.title: Add page titles and SEO metadata
dash.tip.nextSeo.prompt: Add page titles, descriptions and Open Graph metadata to the pages of this Next.js app, plus a sitemap and robots file if they are missing.
dash.tip.reactStates.title: Add loading, empty and error states
dash.tip.reactStates.prompt: Find the components of this React app that load data and give each one a loading, an empty and an error state, with a retry button where it makes sense.
dash.tip.reactA11y.title: Make the UI keyboard and screen-reader friendly
dash.tip.reactA11y.prompt: Review this React app for accessibility: labels on inputs and icon buttons, keyboard access to every control, visible focus, and colour contrast. Fix what you find and list it.
dash.tip.expressValidate.title: Validate the input of every route
dash.tip.expressValidate.prompt: Add input validation to every route of this Express API, return clear 400 errors, and make sure no route trusts the request body or query blindly.
dash.tip.expressHealth.title: Add a health check and a clean shutdown
dash.tip.expressHealth.prompt: Add a /health endpoint to this Express server and make it shut down cleanly on SIGTERM (stop accepting requests, finish the open ones, close database connections).
dash.tip.nodeTests.title: Add tests for the main logic
dash.tip.nodeTests.prompt: Add unit tests for the most important logic of this Node.js project using the test runner it already has (or node:test if none), and make them pass.
dash.tip.sassTokens.title: Turn colours into variables, add dark mode
dash.tip.sassTokens.prompt: Replace the hard-coded colours in the Sass/SCSS files of this project with variables (or CSS custom properties) and add a dark theme that follows prefers-color-scheme.
dash.tip.iosPrivacy.title: Check the iOS privacy strings
dash.tip.iosPrivacy.prompt: Check the iOS project's Info.plist and privacy manifest: every permission the app uses needs a clear usage description. Add or fix them and list what you changed.
dash.tip.androidWarnings.title: Clean up Android build warnings
dash.tip.androidWarnings.prompt: Look at the Android project's Gradle configuration for deprecated settings and outdated SDK levels, fix what is safe to fix, and explain anything that needs a decision from me.
dash.tip.explain.title: Explain this project to me
dash.tip.explain.prompt: Explain this project to me in plain words: what it does, how it is organised, how to run it, and three sensible next steps. Do not change any file.
dash.tip.bugs.title: Find and fix the three worst bugs
dash.tip.bugs.prompt: Look through this project for the three most likely bugs or crashes, explain each one, and fix them with small, safe changes.
dash.tip.readme.title: Write a helpful README
dash.tip.readme.prompt: Write or update the README of this project: what it is, how to install and run it, and how it is organised. Keep it short and accurate.
dash.radar.title: {n, plural, =0 {Needs you} one {Needs you (#)} other {Needs you (#)}}
dash.radar.count: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing waits on you} one {# request waits on you} other {# requests wait on you}}
dash.radar.noneWhy: Permission requests, questions and plans of your runs show up here.
dash.radar.openFailed: The run could not be opened
dash.section.name: Dashboard
dash.section.title: Dashboard
dash.section.desc: A tab of cards with your runs, plan usage, repositories, servers and more. It only reads what IntelyIDE already knows.
dash.section.enableDesc: The Dashboard tab, its cards and the Needs-You radar.
dash.section.atStartDesc: Opens the Dashboard as the first tab when a workspace opens (not in Agent mode).
dash.section.tray: Plan usage in the menu bar
dash.section.trayDesc: Adds the 5-hour plan usage next to the counts of the menu-bar item. Reading it starts the Claude CLI briefly every few minutes.
dash.section.layoutDesc: Order, sizes and hidden cards go back to the default.
